note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk (ebible mirror amh_amh); the mirror carries no Old Testament, so Augustine's constant Psalm and other OT quotations are self_rendered in the 1962 register.

The mirror misfiles or omits some NT verses (e.g. Romans 1:20-22, Ephesians 3:20, 1 Timothy 2:5, Philippians 2:15-16); translators pasted the text from where it actually sits when it was present and self-rendered the rest. A row is mined only when reported verbatim AND the block holds at least 45 characters (or the whole verse) of that verse's on-disk wording.
Augustine quotes the Old Latin, which often differs from the 1962 text; where his reading differs, his sense is kept and the row is adapted/self_rendered.
